title: angular-django2 stepper schematic
description: Compile an OpenUI Stepper element (widgets/stepper) into a standalone OnPush Angular Material stepper component.

name.description: Kebab-case component name. Defaults to the dasherized node id.

path.description: Destination directory within the selected application's source root. Defaults to <sourceRoot>/app.

project.description: Angular application project. Required when the workspace has more than one application.

document.description: Workspace-relative path to a canonical OpenUI JSON document (*.openui.json or *.json). Compiles a Stepper node: uses.selectedIndex, uses.linear, uses.orientation, produces.selectionChange and produces.complete; uses.branching is not supported. Each step child (uses.label, uses.optional) has its children compiled and embedded by uses.slot.

nodeId.description: Optional element ID within the OpenUI document to compile. When omitted, targets the first Stepper element. Requires --document.
